regime_read: The strongest measured convergence is concentrated in AI/cloud demand, aerospace policy exposure, and selected event-driven situations, but several scores rely partly on affiliation or sentiment rather than hard capital-flow evidence. With no completed outcomes in the track record, conviction remains modest and only non-extended names qualify for accumulation.
regime_read_zh: 当前较强的实测汇聚主要集中在AI/云需求、航空航天政策敞口及部分事件驱动机会，但若干评分部分依赖关联关系或情绪信号，而非硬性的资金流证据。由于历史判断尚无已完成评分，整体置信度保持克制，仅考虑尚未过度延伸的标的。

theses.thesis: The cleanest operating convergence combines app demand, developer adoption, model-download momentum, and a sizable patent cluster [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership adds strategic AI distribution linkage [actor:Sam Altman]. Relative strength is positive but below the extension threshold.
theses.thesis_zh: 最清晰的经营信号汇聚来自应用需求、开发者采用、模型下载动量和较大的专利集群 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的事实性合作进一步强化AI分发战略联系 [actor:Sam Altman]。相对强势为正，但尚未达到过度延伸阈值。
second_order: Cloud data-center infrastructure — sustained model and developer activity implies continued compute and networking demand
Enterprise AI software — strong app and GitHub engagement supports downstream deployment tooling
AI power infrastructure — expanding cloud workloads increase electricity and cooling requirements
theses.dissent: Downloads, stars, reviews, and patents can measure ecosystem attention without proving incremental monetization, while the affiliation signal adds little independent confirmation.

falsifier.text: App, GitHub, and model-download momentum roll over together without a corresponding increase in enterprise AI adoption.

AI power and cooling infrastructure — cloud expansion raises downstream facility requirements
Digital advertising technology — stronger platform engagement can support the surrounding ad ecosystem

Advanced packaging — AI-oriented memory growth increases packaging complexity

theses.thesis: Government grants, lobbying activity, and a patent cluster align around continued aerospace-policy and technology investment [gov_grant] [lobbying] [patent_cluster]. The pending FY2027 defense authorization provides a broad sector backdrop, though it is not company-specific [bill:HRES1438]. Stocktwits optimism and Jim Cramer's endorsement are secondary sentiment signals rather than core evidence [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Jim Cramer].
theses.thesis_zh: 政府补助、游说活动和专利集群共同指向航空航天政策及技术投资的延续 [gov_grant] [lobbying] [patent_cluster]。待审的2027财年国防授权为行业提供宏观背景，但并非公司特定催化剂 [bill:HRES1438]。Stocktwits乐观情绪和Jim Cramer背书仅属于次要情绪信号，而非核心证据 [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Jim Cramer]。
second_order: Aerospace suppliers — sustained policy and technology spending can flow through the production chain
Aircraft-component manufacturing — production normalization would raise component demand
Defense electronics — broader FY2027 defense authorization supports the adjacent aerospace ecosystem

falsifier.text: Production or safety execution worsens enough to prevent grants and policy spending from reaching deliveries and cash generation.

second_order: Clinical-research services — numerous Phase 3 starts imply greater trial-management demand
Biopharma manufacturing — successful label expansion can increase downstream production needs
Oncology diagnostics — broader treatment use can support testing and patient-selection demand

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts or an adverse regulatory decision outweigh the label-expansion and Phase 3 catalysts.
